tools.name: keyframe_styles
tools.title: Keyframe · browse formats and prices (free)
tools.description: Lists what Keyframe Studio makes and what it costs: short motion graphics videos and animations (MP4 clips such as countdowns, logo intros and promo clips), from instant templates or made by hand. Shows the formats (launch sting, countdown, portfolio card, kinetic post, price-chart moment, and human Studio commissions) and whether each can be ordered now, styles, aspect ratios, durations, prices in USDC on Base, typical delivery time and sample video links. Every template is designed by hand by Keyframe's designer; agents only fill typed fields. Free; moves no money. If the user already said what they want, go straight to keyframe_quote.

format.description: only this format id, e.g. launch_sting

tools.name: keyframe_quote
tools.title: Keyframe · 1. quote an order (free)
tools.description: Prices an order for a short motion graphics video or animation (an MP4 clip such as a countdown, logo intro or promo clip; keyframe_styles shows which formats can be ordered now) and prepares its pay-on-delivery escrow. Fill only the typed fields; omit optional fields rather than inventing names, colors or numbers the user did not give. buyer is the address of the PayBox wallet that will pay (list_credentials → metadata.address). For portfolio_pulse, first call get_portfolio for that address and pass its result unchanged as params.portfolio. Returns price, delivery time, deadline, a watermarked preview of the key frame, the escrow address (derived from the deal terms and re-checked by this plugin) and the payment route for this wallet. Moves no money. Show the user the price, deadline, preview link and escrow address. Next: the tool named in next.tool. If quote_status is draft (preview pending), call keyframe_status with quote_id after retry_after_ms. Amounts are atomic USDC (1000000 = 1.00 USDC).

buyer.description: address of the PayBox wallet that will pay (list_credentials → metadata.address)

format.description: what to make; new formats added later use catalog

palette.description: omit to use the style's own colors; never invent brand colors

deadline_minutes.description: Instant only: minutes until the delivery deadline

delivery.description: default public; portfolio_pulse defaults to private

rights_confirmed.description: the user owns or may use every name, logo and text supplied, and nothing depicts a real person

logo_url.description: https PNG/WebP/SVG of the user's own logo, at most 2 MB

portfolio.description: the get_portfolio result for the buyer address, passed through unchanged

params.description: typed fields of the chosen format only

from_quote_id.description: re-quote with changes to an earlier quote

options.description: extra catalog options named by keyframe_styles

tools.name: keyframe_commission
tools.title: Keyframe · 2. pay into escrow (1 approval)
tools.description: Creates the payment for a quote as one PayBox approval: an x402 payment of the quoted USDC on Base, gasless for the payer. The money goes to the order's escrow address, never to Keyframe directly. It can pay the studio only if the studio publishes the key to the buyer's file before the deadline; otherwise it can only return to the buyer, automatically. Before proposing, this plugin checks that the quote is still exactly the deal that was reviewed, re-derives the escrow address and checks that the live payment request pays exactly that address and amount. Input: quote_id, buyer and terms_hash exactly as in keyframe_quote's next.input (valid 5 minutes). Use the wallet_id of that buyer wallet. PayBox shows the payee and amount for approval; compare the whole address. After approval, poll get_request until it finishes; never call this tool twice for one quote. Then call keyframe_verify with the paid response.

quote_id.description: Keyframe quote id (q_ + 22 base58 characters), from keyframe_quote

buyer.description: the buyer wallet address from keyframe_quote's next.input (the wallet that pays; refunds can only go there)

terms_hash.description: terms_hash from keyframe_quote's next.input: the deal checked there; payment is refused if the deal changed

tools.name: keyframe_commission_direct
tools.title: Keyframe · 2b. pay by direct transfer (1 approval, needs ETH gas)
tools.description: Payment route for wallets that cannot pay by x402 (for example EIP-7702-delegated wallets), used when keyframe_quote returns route.kind = 'direct' or when the user wants the payee fixed in the transaction itself. Proposes one Base transaction: USDC.transfer(escrow address, exact price). PayBox's window shows the USDC contract as 'to'; the escrow address and amount are inside the data. Needs a little ETH on Base for gas. Input: quote_id, buyer and terms_hash exactly as in keyframe_quote's next.input; the same deal checks as keyframe_commission. Use the wallet_id of that buyer wallet. Poll get_request to success, then call keyframe_verify with mode funding, quote_id and tx_hash.

quote_id.description: Keyframe quote id (q_ + 22 base58 characters), from keyframe_quote

buyer.description: the buyer wallet address from keyframe_quote's next.input (the wallet that pays; refunds can only go there)

terms_hash.description: terms_hash from keyframe_quote's next.input: the deal checked there; payment is refused if the deal changed

tools.name: keyframe_status
tools.title: Keyframe · 3. check an order (free)
tools.description: Order progress: preview ready, sealed (paid into escrow), rendering (percent and time left), key published (delivered and paid), returned (refunded) or void. Accepts quote_id (this also finalizes a quote whose preview was pending; pass buyer to check the deal refunds to that wallet) or order_id (+ access_token for private orders). Waits up to wait_s seconds (max 6) for a change. Free; moves no money. While rendering, call again after poll_after_s. When the state is KEY PUBLISHED or RETURNED, call keyframe_verify.

quote_id.description: Keyframe quote id (q_ + 22 base58 characters), from keyframe_quote

order_id.description: Keyframe order id (o_ + 22 base58 characters), from the paid response

access_token.description: access_token from the paid response or keyframe_orders (private order details)

buyer.description: the buyer wallet address the quote was requested for; checked against the deal (refunds can only go there)

wait_s.description: wait up to this many seconds for a change

tools.name: keyframe_verify
tools.title: Keyframe · 4. verify delivery independently (free)
tools.description: Proves an order's state from Base and public storage instead of trusting Keyframe's server. It recomputes the escrow address from the terms and checks the funding transfer and the escrow's balance and code on two Base RPCs. After delivery it reads the key from the escrow factory's on-chain record, downloads the encrypted file, decrypts it here, and checks its fingerprint, length and resolution against the terms. mode derive works offline (escrow math only); funding checks the payment; delivery checks the key and the file. Accepts the paid response from get_request, or quote_id/order_id (+ tx_hash for direct payments), or the terms themselves. Free; moves no money. Report each check to the user.

mode.description: derive: offline escrow math; funding: is the money sealed; delivery: is the key published and the file intact

terms.description: Terms v1 JSON exactly as in the quote (amount is atomic USDC)

factory.description: escrow factory address (required with terms in derive mode)

escrow.description: an escrow address to compare against the derivation

quote_id.description: Keyframe quote id (q_ + 22 base58 characters), from keyframe_quote

order_id.description: Keyframe order id (o_ + 22 base58 characters), from the paid response

access_token.description: access_token from the paid response or keyframe_orders (private order details)

paid_response.description: the paid response (or the whole get_request result) of keyframe_commission

tx_hash.description: transaction hash of a direct-rail payment

k_buyer.description: k_buyer of a private order (from the paid response or keyframe_orders)

max_chunks.description: cap on encrypted chunks to download and check

tools.name: keyframe_refund
tools.title: Keyframe · return funds after deadline (fallback)
tools.description: Fallback only. Refunds are automatic: after the deadline, Keyframe's keepers (or anyone) return the escrowed USDC to the buyer. If keyframe_status still shows funds in escrow after the deadline, this proposes the same public refund call from the buyer's wallet (one approval, needs a little ETH on Base). The money can only go to the buyer. action sweep returns late or extra funds after an order has settled; action reject is the buyer's own Studio-review rejection. Refuses with the exact time when an action is not allowed yet.

action.description: refund: after the deadline; sweep: late or extra funds; reject: Studio review rejection (buyer only)

terms.description: Terms v1 JSON exactly as in the quote (amount is atomic USDC)

quote_id.description: Keyframe quote id (q_ + 22 base58 characters), from keyframe_quote

order_id.description: Keyframe order id (o_ + 22 base58 characters), from the paid response

access_token.description: access_token from the paid response or keyframe_orders (private order details)

token.description: sweep only: asset to return (default the deal's USDC; 0x0…0 for ETH)

tools.name: keyframe_review
tools.title: Keyframe · Studio review: accept, changes or reject
tools.description: For Studio orders whose watermarked preview is ready. decision: accept (pay the designer now), changes (ask for the one included revision) or reject (refund to the buyer, minus the kill fee in the deal, if any). The first call returns an EIP-712 message. Confirm with the user, sign it with request_wallet_sign (no gas; moves no money by itself), then call again with the signature and sig_deadline. This plugin only passes on messages for Keyframe's own escrow contract and builds the change request itself. Without a change request, doing nothing until the review window ends counts as accept. After a change request nothing is released on silence: one revision may be delivered, and only the buyer's explicit accept releases payment, possible until the order's changes.accept_by (after the on-chain review window Keyframe verifies the signed accept itself; a reject then is a full refund); otherwise the USDC returns to the buyer in full after the review window plus 3 days.

order_id.description: Keyframe order id (o_ + 22 base58 characters), from the paid response

access_token.description: access_token from the paid response or keyframe_orders (private order details)

signature.description: the request_wallet_sign result for the typed data from the first call

tools.name: keyframe_orders
tools.title: Keyframe · find my orders (free)
tools.description: Lists a buyer's Keyframe orders with fresh access links, for use in a new chat. The first call returns a sign-in message (EIP-4361) for request_wallet_sign; call again with the message and the signature. This plugin checks that the message signs in to Keyframe only. Free; moves no money.

message.description: the sign-in message from the first call, unchanged
